## Purpose
The controls that say where a rule belongs and whom it applies to: a category picker (with "new category" in place) and an "Apply to" picker that can point the rule at specific agents or workflows.

## Responsibilities
- `CategoryBadge`, `CategoryPicker`, `TargetPicker` and `AppliesPicker`.
